title: Case Study Review Comments Log (Rolling) — Reference Program
content:
Purpose
- Single place to track internal + customer feedback/redlines for case studies and reference profiles.
- Use this log during weekly review with Marketing/Legal/Security/SE to unblock approvals.

Legend
- Severity: S1 (must-fix legal/security), S2 (must-fix accuracy/claims), S3 (style/clarity)
- Status: Open | In progress | Pending customer | Pending legal | Resolved | Dropped

Current drafts in motion
- Arcadia Health — Private (VPC) deployment story (regulated workload)
- QuantaPay — Dedicated capacity story (strict latency/throughput)
- NovaDocs — Hosted API + Optimize story (cost + caching/batching)


LOG (most recent on top)

Row | Date | Customer | Asset | Section | Comment / Redline | Severity | Proposed Change | Owner | Status | Notes/Links
----|------|----------|-------|---------|-------------------|----------|-----------------|-------|--------|------------
47 | 2025-06-15 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web+PDF) | Metrics (latency) | Customer asked to remove “guaranteed p95 < 250ms” phrasing; they will not approve any guarantee language tied to their workload. | S1 | Replace with “observed p95 latency improved to X ms in POC window (see measurement notes); production results may vary by prompt length and concurrency.” | Ethan Wallace | Resolved | Source: email thread soojin_lee 20250607; align with SLA language.
46 | 2025-06-15 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Security / Compliance | Remove mention of “HSM-backed keys” — they use KMS but don’t want to specify key custody details publicly. | S1 | Change to “customer-managed keys via cloud KMS integration; audit logs enabled.” | Naomi Feldman | Pending customer | Confirm exact approved wording in final approval packet.
45 | 2025-06-14 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Claims (cost) | Internal review flagged “50% cheaper per query” as ambiguous (what’s a query? includes rerank? includes egress?). | S2 | Reword to “reduced blended cost per search (embedding + rerank) by ~X% vs baseline in May window; includes token + embedding units; excludes downstream vector DB costs.” | Sana Farid | In progress | Need final X% from worksheet; ask Logan for export screenshot.
44 | 2025-06-14 | QuantaPay | Quote block | Quote attribution | Customer wants spokesperson title changed from “Head of Platform” to “Director, Infrastructure.” | S2 | Update quote attribution + release form to match. | Sofia Mendes | In progress | Legal wants exact title on release.
43 | 2025-06-14 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (PDF) | Architecture diagram | Arcadia requested removing region identifiers and internal network segmentation labels. | S1 | Generalize diagram: “VPC (private subnets) → Redwood Private control plane → Dedicated GPU pool”; remove region and subnet names. | Tessa Morgan | In progress | Align with security-review transcript 2025-05-13.
42 | 2025-06-13 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Metrics (methodology footnote) | Add explicit measurement window + traffic description; customer asked that the footnote not reference “customer production logs” (they want “observability dashboards”). | S2 | Footnote: “Measured via Redwood Console dashboards over a 14-day window; workload consisted of doc-search queries with median prompt length ~X tokens.” | Ethan Wallace | Pending customer | Waiting for NovaDocs token stats confirmation.
41 | 2025-06-13 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Reliability | Internal: do not claim “zero downtime” during POC given SUP-2444 latency regression investigation. | S1 | Replace with “no Sev-1 incidents during the measurement window; one p95 regression was mitigated via kernel selection update.” | Markus Klein | Resolved | Link jira:SUP-2444; keep incident wording factual.
40 | 2025-06-12 | Arcadia Health | Reference profile (internal) | Reference call boundaries | CS requested we add “no roadmap commitments” and “no pricing discussion” to the standard boundaries list. | S2 | Add to Arcadia internal one-pager + general template. | Rachel Kim | Resolved | See email rachel_kim 20250612.
39 | 2025-06-12 | QuantaPay | Customer release form | Withdrawal clause | Customer redlined withdrawal language; they want ability to revoke logo/quotes with 10 business days notice (not 30). | S1 | Accept 10 business days for this account; update internal checklist for QuantaPay exception. | Michael Grant | Pending legal | Source: thread michael_grant 20250610.
38 | 2025-06-12 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Product naming | Customer prefers “Redwood Optimize recommendations” not “autopilot optimization.” | S3 | Replace term throughout. | Soojin Lee | Resolved | Consistency with product marketing.
37 | 2025-06-11 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Claims (audit logs) | Legal flagged “HIPAA-ready audit logs” as a compliance claim; we cannot imply HIPAA certification. | S1 | Change to “audit logging and export supported to help meet internal compliance requirements.” | Naomi Feldman | Resolved | Must apply across all stories.
36 | 2025-06-11 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Dedicated capacity | Customer requested clarification that burst behavior required pre-configured policy and wasn’t “automatic.” | S2 | Add line: “Burst capacity enabled via pre-agreed autoscaling policy; Redwood worked with QuantaPay to set concurrency limits + warm pools.” | Simran Kaur | Resolved | Matches ff_2025-05-08 demo notes.
35 | 2025-06-10 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Data retention | Arcadia asked to remove “30-day retention” because their retention differs by log type; wants non-specific. | S2 | Replace with “configurable retention policies for logs/telemetry.” | Ethan Wallace | Pending customer | Verify approved phrasing in final review.
34 | 2025-06-10 | QuantaPay | Public case study (PDF) | Metrics table | Internal: metrics table must include baseline definition + hardware notes; otherwise comparisons are misleading. | S2 | Add baseline column: “Previous provider (managed endpoint)”; add hardware note “A100-class GPU pool (Redwood Dedicated)” without specifying exact count. | Markus Klein | In progress | Confirm what can be published re: GPU count.
33 | 2025-06-09 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Claims (quality) | Customer pushed back on “no quality regression” unless tied to eval set; they want it phrased as “maintained relevance.” | S2 | Update to “maintained search relevance on internal eval set; monitored via prompt set + clickthrough proxy.” | Soojin Lee | In progress | Need details from ff_2025-05-28 deep dive.
32 | 2025-06-09 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Private deployment description | Security review: avoid describing exact network topology (e.g., “peering to X”). | S1 | Use generic “customer-managed networking; private connectivity.” | Naomi Feldman | Resolved | Based on ff_2025-05-13 security review.
31 | 2025-06-08 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Latency claim | Customer asked to add caveat re: prompt length distribution; their improvements are for typical prompts < 1k tokens. | S2 | Add footnote: “results reflect typical request sizes; long-context requests will have different latency curves.” | Ethan Wallace | Resolved | Included in measurement notes.
30 | 2025-06-08 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Architecture | Internal: clarify they use embeddings + reranking (not “RAG end-to-end”) to avoid implying full orchestration. | S3 | Rewrite solution overview to focus on “retrieval stack integration” and “reranking endpoint.” | Markus Klein | Resolved | Keep it simple for web.
29 | 2025-06-07 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Headline | Customer will not approve “QuantaPay hits sub-200ms p95” as headline; too specific. | S2 | Replace headline with outcome framing: “Predictable p95 latency under peak load with Dedicated capacity.” | Camila Reyes | Resolved | Coordinate with design layout.
28 | 2025-06-07 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Logo usage | Arcadia requested: logo can appear on case study page but not on Redwood homepage or paid ads. | S1 | Add logo scope limitations to release form and internal tracking field “logo_scope=case-study-only.” | Sofia Mendes | Pending legal | Ensure Ben’s web rollout complies.
27 | 2025-06-06 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Metrics (cost) | Internal: “cost/token” phrasing confusing for embedding-heavy workloads; prefer “cost per search.” | S2 | Use “cost per search” and include breakdown line item: embedding + rerank. | Sana Farid | Resolved | Use Redwood Console cost export.
26 | 2025-06-05 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Reliability | Customer asked not to mention prior provider by name. | S1 | Change “Migrated from Provider X” → “Migrated from a managed model endpoint.” | Ethan Wallace | Resolved | Keep competitive-neutral.
25 | 2025-06-05 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Compliance language | Customer wants “SOC 2” mentioned only as “Redwood provided SOC 2 report under NDA,” not public claim implying their procurement outcome. | S1 | Add: “SOC 2 report available under NDA.” Remove “SOC 2 cleared” phrasing. | Michael Grant | Resolved | Align with security language policy.
24 | 2025-06-04 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Quote | Customer quote needs to remove “cheaper than OpenAI” comparison. | S1 | Replace with outcome-based quote focused on budget predictability + caching. | Soojin Lee | Resolved | Avoid vendor comparisons.
23 | 2025-06-03 | HelioSupport | Reference-only profile (internal) | Streaming stability | SE notes: do not claim “streaming stability solved” yet; ongoing timeouts in POC. | S1 | Keep HelioSupport as reference-call-only, not case study candidate until SUP-2410 closed. | Markus Klein | Resolved | Link jira:SUP-2410; update target list separately.
22 | 2025-06-02 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Metrics (error rate) | Internal: don’t publish absolute error rate without defining denominator and error classes (429 vs 5xx). | S2 | Convert to “reduced timeout/429 incidence after tuning rate limits” and include definition footnote. | Logan Wright | In progress | Need exact definitions from Console export.
21 | 2025-06-01 | QuantaPay | Public case study (PDF) | Security section | Customer requested removing mention of “on-prem option” (not relevant; implies their evaluation). | S3 | Cut sentence; keep focus on Dedicated. | Ethan Wallace | Resolved | Keep story tight.
20 | 2025-05-31 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Audit logs wording | Customer asked to specify “export format” not “full-fidelity logs” language. | S2 | Add: “Audit logs exportable (JSON/CSV) on a scheduled cadence.” | Simran Kaur | Resolved | Reference jira:SUP-2381 resolution.
19 | 2025-05-30 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Optimize claims | Internal: avoid implying Redwood changes prompts automatically. | S2 | Clarify: “Optimize surfaced recommendations; NovaDocs applied changes to batching/caching policy.” | Soojin Lee | Resolved | Messaging consistency.
18 | 2025-05-29 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Customer identifiers | Customer: do not name internal app, business unit, or patient domain. | S1 | Generalize to “clinical operations workflows” and remove app name placeholders. | Ethan Wallace | Resolved | Confirmed in kickoff transcript.
17 | 2025-05-28 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Throughput | Internal: “3x throughput” needs baseline (same model? same tokens? same concurrency?). | S2 | Add baseline statement + model/version pin note; only publish after validation worksheet signed off. | Sana Farid | In progress | Waiting on final benchmark run.
16 | 2025-05-28 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Architecture diagram | Customer requested diagram include “vector DB” box but no vendor name. | S3 | Add generic “Vector DB” component. | Tessa Morgan | Resolved | No vendor lock-in implied.
15 | 2025-05-27 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Private deployment wording | Internal: avoid “air-gapped” term; not accurate for Arcadia. | S2 | Replace with “private network deployment (VPC).” | Naomi Feldman | Resolved | Accuracy.
14 | 2025-05-26 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Console screenshots | Legal: screenshots must not include request IDs, regions, or account identifiers. | S1 | Blur/redact fields; use staged data if needed. | Ben Carter | In progress | If redaction too heavy, replace with recreated charts.
13 | 2025-05-25 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Statement on PHI | Customer: must explicitly state “no PHI sent to Redwood” (their policy). | S1 | Add line: “Workloads configured so no protected health information (PHI) is transmitted.” | Michael Grant | Pending customer | Needs Arcadia confirmation (some metadata may still be present).
12 | 2025-05-25 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Terminology | Internal: use “reranking” not “re-ranking” for consistency. | S3 | Global find/replace. | Ethan Wallace | Resolved | Style.
11 | 2025-05-24 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | Conditional participation | AE notes: case study contingent on meeting acceptance thresholds; avoid publishing until procurement says OK. | S1 | Mark QuantaPay as “conditional” in tracking; keep draft internal-only. | Priyom Das | Resolved | From thread 20250524.
10 | 2025-05-23 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Metrics precision | SE requested to avoid “~” ranges without backing data; use exact p50/p95 from agreed window or remove. | S2 | Replace rough numbers with validated metrics or convert to directional statements. | Markus Klein | In progress | Metrics validation call scheduled.
09 | 2025-05-23 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Claims (SLA) | Internal: don’t reference Dedicated SLA on a Private deployment story. | S2 | Remove SLA mention; keep reliability narrative qualitative + incident response workflow. | Soojin Lee | Resolved | Prevent capability confusion.
08 | 2025-05-22 | NovaDocs | Public case study (web) | Customer quote approvals | Customer asked that quotes be pre-approved as a list; no “editable” live doc comments. | S1 | Switch to quote approval table + release form. | Sofia Mendes | Resolved | Use standard release template.
07 | 2025-05-22 | QuantaPay | Public case study (web) | “Always-on” language | Customer said “always-on capacity” reads like unused reserved spend; prefer “reserved capacity with predictable throughput.” | S3 | Rephrase sentence + headline support copy. | Camila Reyes | Resolved | Messaging.
06 | 2025-05-21 | Arcadia Health | Public case study (web) | Intro | Marketing: lead with regulated constraints (VPC, audit logs, retention) before outcomes; current draft feels feature-first. | S3 | Reorder: constraints → approach → outcomes. | Ethan Wallace | Resolved | Align with messaging framework.
05 | 2025-05-21 | General | Template | Metrics footnote | Add standard footnote template for all metrics: window, model version, region, request shape, what’s excluded. | S2 | Update template pack; require completion before external review. | Sana Farid | In progress | Track as separate checklist item.

Open questions / parking lot
- Are we comfortable publishing any absolute $ values for NovaDocs? (customer has hinted ‘no’)
- For QuantaPay, can we publish GPU type class (“A100-class”) or should we stick to “dedicated GPU pool”? Waiting on their brand/comms.
- For Arcadia, confirm whether “no PHI transmitted” is strictly true given potential metadata/logs. Needs customer sign-off.

Next review meeting (internal)
- Tue 2025-06-17 10:00–10:45 PT (Marketing + Legal + Security + SE)
Agenda: clear QuantaPay metrics language, finalize Arcadia diagram redactions, unblock NovaDocs cost metric definition.
